correctness.rationale: For the canonical unit-weight graph associahedron of K_{p,q} (p≤q, p→∞, n=p+q), support width additivity and the dichromatic connected-subset criterion give exactly 2^{-n}width(z)=H_n(z)-2^{-p}H_q(z_B)-2^{-q}H_p(z_A), H_m(z)=Σ2^{-r}(z_(r)-z_(m+1-r)). Projected Gaussian directions normalized by χ_{n-1} give sphere widths; radial error b_n²/√n→0. Gaussian maxima/minima have independent Poisson extremes and the geometric weights admit a true L1-uniform tail via beta order-statistics, not just fixed K convergence. The two class subtractions reduce to 2^{1-p}b_n at scale 1/b_n; hence b_n(√(n-1)W/2^n-2(1-2^{-p})b_n) converges to Xi_++Xi_-, each Xi=-Σ2^{-r}logΓ_r. The alternate 2b_n centering shifts by -4(log n)/2^p. Gamma-log covariance summation proves the stated mean/variance; a one-sided exponential lower tail shows non-Gaussianity.
risks: Asymptotic requires p_n→∞, unweighted Minkowski-sum realization and Haar unit directions in 1-perp; no fixed-p claim. Finite checks cannot establish the infinite Gaussian Poisson point-process limit.
